guitar.title: Campfire Guitar
guitar.outcome: Play one complete song confidently for friends.

techniques.title: Comfortable posture and clean sound
techniques.description: Hold the guitar without tension and make every string ring clearly.
techniques.whyItMatters: Comfort prevents fatigue and gives every later technique a clean foundation.

techniques.title: Build two reliable open chords
techniques.description: Place G and C accurately, then rebuild both shapes from a relaxed hand.
techniques.whyItMatters: Two clean chords turn isolated finger shapes into something musical.

techniques.title: Smooth chord transitions
techniques.description: Move between G, C, and D with one economical hand movement.
techniques.whyItMatters: Smooth transitions bridge the gap between knowing chords and playing a song.
practiceTasks: Keep the loop at a slow pulse
keyPoints: Look at the next chord early

techniques.title: Natural down-up strumming
techniques.description: Use a relaxed wrist to create an even and repeatable groove.
techniques.whyItMatters: A steady strumming motion makes simple chords sound musical.

techniques.title: One versatile rhythm pattern
techniques.description: Turn a continuous strum into one recognizable song groove.
techniques.whyItMatters: One flexible rhythm pattern can unlock dozens of beginner songs.
practiceTasks: Play the pattern on one chord

techniques.title: Recover without stopping
techniques.description: Keep the beat and rejoin the song after a missed chord or strum.
techniques.whyItMatters: Listeners notice a stopped rhythm more than one imperfect chord.
practiceTasks: Rejoin on the next strong beat

techniques.title: Play your first complete song
techniques.description: Combine the chord loop and rhythm into a complete performance.
techniques.whyItMatters: A finished song is motivating proof that focused practice worked.
keyPoints: Practice the transition, not the whole song

chess.title: Confident Casual Chess
chess.outcome: Play complete games with a repeatable thinking process and fewer avoidable mistakes.

techniques.title: Board vision and safe pieces
techniques.description: Scan attacked and undefended pieces before choosing a move.
techniques.whyItMatters: Most beginner games are decided by one-move piece losses rather than advanced theory.
practiceTasks: Repeat the scan before ten moves

techniques.title: Opening principles without memorization
techniques.description: Develop pieces, influence the center, and secure the king without learning long theory.
techniques.whyItMatters: A healthy position gives you playable choices even in unfamiliar openings.

techniques.title: Checks, captures, and threats
techniques.description: Examine forcing moves for both players before committing to a plan.
techniques.whyItMatters: A short forcing-move scan catches tactical opportunities and prevents immediate blunders.

techniques.title: Forks and pins
techniques.description: Recognize and create two high-frequency tactical patterns.
techniques.whyItMatters: A small tactical vocabulary gives immediate practical returns.

techniques.title: A repeatable move checklist
techniques.description: Use the same compact decision process before every serious move.
techniques.whyItMatters: A consistent process is more useful at casual level than memorizing many disconnected ideas.

techniques.title: Essential king-and-pawn endings
techniques.description: Use king activity, opposition, and passed pawns in simple endings.
techniques.whyItMatters: Knowing one basic ending turns close games into confident wins or draws.

photography.title: Better Everyday Photos
photography.outcome: Create a consistent five-photo story using intentional light and composition.

techniques.title: Read light before changing settings
techniques.description: Notice direction, softness, and contrast before taking the photo.
techniques.whyItMatters: Light changes the subject more than an expensive camera or preset.
practiceTasks: Photograph one subject from three directions
keyPoints: Turn the subject before adding gear

techniques.title: Build a clear composition
techniques.description: Simplify the frame and use placement to make the subject obvious.
techniques.whyItMatters: A clear composition helps the viewer understand the photo immediately.

techniques.title: Control motion intentionally
techniques.description: Choose whether movement should look frozen or visibly dynamic.
techniques.whyItMatters: Intentional motion makes action photos feel deliberate instead of accidental.

techniques.title: Use depth to separate the subject
techniques.description: Control foreground, subject distance, and background to create depth.
techniques.whyItMatters: Depth makes a flat image feel more intentional and immersive.

techniques.title: Create one restrained edit
techniques.description: Correct exposure and color while preserving a natural-looking subject.
techniques.whyItMatters: A repeatable edit creates consistency without hiding weak captures.
practiceTasks: Apply the edit to three photos

techniques.title: Finish a five-photo story
techniques.description: Select and sequence five images that show place, detail, action, and conclusion.
techniques.whyItMatters: A finished story develops judgment better than collecting unrelated good photos.
practiceTasks: Edit down to exactly five photos

drawing.title: Confident Sketching
drawing.outcome: Finish one expressive object study with believable form and proportion.

techniques.title: See simple shapes first
techniques.description: Break a complex object into circles, boxes, and directional lines.
techniques.whyItMatters: Simple construction prevents details from hiding proportion mistakes.

techniques.title: Build confident lines
techniques.description: Prepare the motion, then draw longer lines from the shoulder.
techniques.whyItMatters: Confident marks make even a simple study feel intentional.
practiceTasks: Use one line per chosen edge

techniques.title: Check proportion with landmarks
techniques.description: Compare angles, alignments, and relative lengths before refining the drawing.
techniques.whyItMatters: A few reliable checks catch structural errors early.

techniques.title: Turn shape into form
techniques.description: Use one light direction to describe planes and rounded surfaces.
techniques.whyItMatters: Value structure makes a flat outline feel three-dimensional.

techniques.title: Create believable depth
techniques.description: Use convergence and overlap to place the object in a simple space.
techniques.whyItMatters: Basic perspective keeps constructed forms from feeling tilted or disconnected.

techniques.title: Finish one expressive study
techniques.description: Combine construction, proportion, line, and value in one finished object drawing.
techniques.whyItMatters: Finishing reveals which fundamentals transfer into a complete result.

custom.title: Focused Hobby Essentials
custom.outcome: Reach one personally meaningful milestone through six focused techniques.

techniques.title: Set up the essential foundation
techniques.description: Learn the minimum setup and safety needed to practice well.
techniques.whyItMatters: A reliable foundation prevents avoidable frustration later.

techniques.title: Learn one reliable core technique
techniques.description: Practice the most reusable action for the selected hobby.
techniques.whyItMatters: One dependable technique creates more progress than many shallow tips.
practiceTasks: Compare the first and last attempt

techniques.title: Connect technique to a real outcome
techniques.description: Apply the core technique in one small and realistic result.
techniques.whyItMatters: Application makes learning memorable and exposes the next useful gap.

techniques.title: Fix the most common mistake
techniques.description: Recognize and correct the failure pattern that blocks most early progress.
techniques.whyItMatters: Removing one repeated mistake is more valuable than adding another technique.
practiceTasks: Repeat until the correction is recognizable

techniques.title: Build a feedback loop
techniques.description: Use a short attempt, review, and adjustment cycle during practice.
techniques.whyItMatters: Feedback turns repetition into deliberate improvement.

techniques.title: Complete a personal milestone
techniques.description: Combine the focused techniques into one finished personal result.
techniques.whyItMatters: A completed milestone proves progress and clarifies what to learn next.
